items.title: On-campus: an easy start
items.detail: Close to class, simple setup. You often have to apply early.

items.title: Off-campus: more options
items.detail: Compare rent and location. You can share costs with flatmates.

items.title: Read the lease carefully
items.detail: Deposit, notice period and who pays the bills: it should all be in writing.

items.title: Avoid scams
items.detail: Never send an advance without seeing the place or signing a contract.

youtube.title: Where to live abroad? On-campus vs off-campus
